purpose: Validation interface for future, separately human-produced cost-analysis artifacts; this contract performs no analysis.

semantic_classes.SOURCE_FACT: A monetary or factual statement preserved with its source context.
semantic_classes.RAW_DATA_VALUE: A value directly present in the supplied analysis dataset.
semantic_classes.DERIVED_STATISTIC: A result reproducibly computed from an admitted dataset and identified method/code.
semantic_classes.MODEL_STATISTICAL_INTERPRETATION: An interpretation supported by admitted analytical output.
semantic_classes.AUTHOR_EDITORIAL_RECOMMENDATION: An author/editor recommendation that is not a statistical result.
